name: Ancient Koraidon ex Starter Deck & Build Set

releases.name: Ancient Koraidon ex Starter Deck & Build Set

description.text: Starter Deck & Build Set Ancient Koraidon ex, released on 26 January 2024 with the Wild Force and Cyber Judge expansions and with Future Miraidon ex's: a ready-built 60-card deck around a new Koraidon ex, an Ancient Pokémon of the Dragon type whose Kaiser Tackle does 280 damage (and 60 to itself), with Ancient Pokémon such as Scream Tail and Great Tusk. Each box held 228 cards of 61 kinds: the deck and 168 extra cards for improving it, the same in both boxes, 112 of them basic Energy (14 of each type). Strong cards such as the ACE SPEC Master Ball, Radiant Greninja, Pidgeot ex, Iono and Counter Catcher are among them. A card box, a coin, a playmat, damage counters and markers, a VSTAR marker and guides to the deck and the extra cards came with it. The two boxes' cards carry their own expansion marks. This set holds the 53 kinds besides basic Energy.
